The three core services are BUILD, FIX and CARE.

value.field_p5_servicesservicedetails_services: Build a website that makes your business easier to understand, trust and contact.

BUILD is for businesses that need a new website, a substantial rebuild, or a focused landing page.

The work brings strategy, structure, UX/UI and development together so the finished website works as one coherent experience.

Typical scope can include:

  • Website strategy and content structure
  • UX/UI design
  • Responsive development
  • CMS when needed
  • Forms, booking and standard integrations
  • Multilingual implementation when required
  • Analytics and search foundations
  • QA, launch and handoff

Investment: Starting at C$3,500 for a focused one-language landing page. Typical website investment: C$5,000–8,000. Custom projects: C$10,000+. All prices are in Canadian dollars. Applicable taxes are added when required.
Improve the website you already have — without rebuilding it unnecessarily.

FIX is for websites that are fundamentally usable but have specific problems affecting clarity, usability or reliability.

That may include a confusing mobile experience, slow pages, broken forms or booking, WordPress or other technical problems, analytics issues, accessibility foundations or other technical friction.

Magneto follows a simple process:

Diagnose → Prioritize → Approve → Fix → Verify

You know what is being fixed before the work starts, and the result is checked afterward.

Common FIX work can include:

  • Mobile and usability problems
  • Forms and booking issues
  • Performance improvements
  • WordPress or other technical problems
  • Analytics setup or corrections
  • Accessibility foundations
  • Technical reliability issues

Most bounded issues can move directly to a FIX estimate. If the website needs a deeper technical review before the work can be responsibly scoped, a Paid Website Diagnostic may be recommended first.
Keep your website maintained, monitored and supported.

CARE is ongoing support for websites that are already in good working condition.

Depending on the plan, CARE can include routine maintenance, monitoring, critical form or booking-flow checks, website health review, small changes and ongoing website support.

Sites built by Magneto can move into CARE after launch when appropriate. If an existing site was not built by Magneto, a Paid Website Diagnostic is required before CARE acceptance and any existing problems may need to be stabilized through FIX first.
One audience. One offer. One clear next step.

A focused landing page is a BUILD project for a specific service, campaign or offer when an entire website is not required.

It can include focused page structure, UX/UI designed around one clear next step, forms or booking, analytics foundations and multilingual implementation when needed.

Landing pages can support referrals, search or paid campaigns. Magneto builds the page; ad campaign management is not included.
Serve your audience clearly in English, French and Spanish.

Multilingual implementation can include adapting approved website copy between English, French and Spanish when included in the project scope.

Magneto can structure and build multilingual experiences while keeping navigation, content hierarchy and calls to action consistent across languages.

Language scope affects project complexity and is assessed as part of the applicable BUILD, FIX or CARE work.

Certified or specialized translation is not included. Final translated copy is subject to client approval.
Make it easier for the right visitor to take the next step.

Depending on the business, the website can connect visitors to contact forms, booking systems, Calendly, newsletter or email capture, WhatsApp and other standard inquiry flows.

The goal is not to add tools for their own sake. The right flow depends on what the visitor needs to do next.
Give the website the technical basics it needs to work responsibly.

When relevant to the project, Magneto can include analytics setup, search / SEO foundations, accessibility foundations, CMS configuration and standard third-party integrations.

Advanced automation, AI systems, complex e-commerce, custom application logic or unusual infrastructure require separate assessment and may become a Custom project.

value.field_p5_packagescontentsections_section:
Most projects start with a conversation and a look at what is publicly visible on your website.

A Paid Website Diagnostic is used when technical unknowns make a responsible estimate impossible, or before CARE begins on a website Magneto did not build.

You receive the evidence, priorities and a recommended direction for a C$450 fixed fee that you approve before it starts.
Good to Know Before You Budget

What affects the price

  • Number of pages and amount of content
  • Number of languages
  • An online store or payments
  • Connecting other systems beyond standard forms and booking
  • Moving a large amount of content from an old website

What you provide or arrange separately

  • Website text and photos; full copywriting and photography are quoted separately
  • Certified or specialized translation. Multilingual copy adaptation by Magneto can be included in the project scope and is subject to client approval.
  • Ongoing SEO, content or advertising management
  • Hosting, domain and third-party tools, paid directly in your own accounts

fields.label: aboutData.generalText
fields.value:
What Magneto delivers

  • Clear, professional websites that make services easier to understand and act on.
  • Focused improvements when an existing website can be fixed without an unnecessary rebuild.
  • Ongoing website care for businesses that need reliable maintenance and support.
  • Multilingual websites in English, French and Spanish when the project needs them.
  • Practical guidance from strategy through launch.

Who Magneto works best with

Magneto works mainly with wellness professionals, therapists and professional service businesses — and with other Montreal service businesses when the project is a good fit.

The best fit is a business that values clarity, thoughtful design, reliable implementation and direct communication with the person doing the work.

Recommend first. Build second.

Every project starts by understanding the actual business and website problem.

Sometimes the right answer is a new website. Sometimes it is a focused fix. Sometimes the existing site needs only small improvements or ongoing care.

Magneto's role is to recommend the most sensible path first — then design and build what the business actually needs.

  • One point of contact from strategy through implementation
  • UX/UI and development handled together
  • Multilingual capability when the project requires it
  • No unnecessary rebuilds or unsupported promises

Have a website project in mind?

If your website is outdated, unclear or difficult to use — or you are not sure what needs to change — send a few details and Magneto will suggest a sensible next step.

Dangel is a holistic and intuitive therapist in Montreal who works with clients in French, English and Spanish.

The website needed to present several therapeutic services without overwhelming visitors, work clearly across three languages, and remain editable by the owner.

Magneto handled the project from strategy through launch, including UX/UI design, development, multilingual implementation, booking and contact paths, cookie-consent controls, measurement of form submissions and booking-link clicks, and a written administration guide.

value.field_689bb6b409f8b: Magneto's own project: an online shop and blog combined in one website, with one search across both and a newsletter signup.
value.field_689bb6ca09f8c:
Shamanicca is Mauricio's own brand, not a client project. Its shop offers apparel, accessories and objects with mystical themes, and its blog publishes articles on spiritual practice.

The site had to bring a shop and a blog together under one brand, stay easy to extend as products and articles are added, and give visitors a way to stay in touch by email.

Magneto designed and developed the website, and continues maintaining and developing it as a live project.

Own project · BUILD · Strategy · UX/UI Design · Development · Online shop · Blog

The project needed a way to stay in touch with visitors by email, not only through social media.

field_689bb725dc084.field_689bb725dc085: Put the shop and the blog under one navigation and one search that covers both products and articles.
Built the shopping experience around category pages, product pages with images and size choice, a wishlist and a shopping bag.
Kept products and articles managed in WordPress and WooCommerce, with shared page layouts so new items do not need a new design each time.
Added a newsletter signup, cookie-consent choice and privacy policy.
